overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating generative reading comprehension metrics using the MOCHA dataset. It uses human evaluations extensively (40K annotations) and compares various automatic metrics. The key contribution is LERC, a learned evaluation metric. The original extraction was generally good but had some redundancy in output descriptions and incorrect classification of LERC as an LLM-as-judge approach.
